title: Compatibility of HRS tilt and completion of $t$-structures in triangulated categories
summary: Let $K$ be a field, and $\mathcal{T}$ a $K$-linear essentially small triangulated category equipped with an extendable $t$-structure $(\mathcal{T}^{\leq0}, \mathcal{T}^{\geq0})$ with respect to a good metric $\mathfrak{B}$. Given a torsion class $\mathcal{X}$ in the heart of $(\mathcal{T}^{\leq0}, \mathcal{T}^{\geq0})$, we prove that lifting the HRS-tilt of $(\mathcal{T}^{\leq0}, \mathcal{T}^{\geq0})$ at $\mathcal{X}$ along the completion of $\mathcal{T}$ coincides with the HRS-tilt of the lifted $t$-structure at the completion of $\mathcal{X}$.
